def train(a):
 cfg,inputs,Model,objective,Sampler,canonical=load(a);assert json.loads((a.run/'entry_gate.json').read_text())['status']=='PASS';j=cfg['jobs'][a.job];out=a.run/a.job;out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
 if cfg.get('contract'):
  approval=json.loads((a.run/'PRIMARY_APPROVAL.json').read_text())
  assert approval['status']=='APPROVED' and approval['contract_sha256']==sha(a.run/'CONTRACT.md')
 pp=a.run/'plans'/j['plan'];plan=read_plan(pp/'plan.npz');rows=json.loads((pp/'rows.json').read_text());sampler=Sampler(inputs['manifest'],exclude_dataset='PSM')
 assert all(r['dataset'] in j['sources'] and canonical(r['dataset'])!='PSM' for r in rows)
 seed=j.get('seed',cfg.get('seed',0));torch.manual_seed(seed);np.random.seed(seed);model=Model(inputs['official'],mode=j['mode']).cuda();initial={n:p.detach().cpu().clone() for n,p in model.named_parameters()}
 opt=torch.optim.AdamW([p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad],lr=.0003,weight_decay=.01);history=[];best=float('inf');stale=0;start=time.time();torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats()
 for step in range(1,10001):
  model.train();x,y=batch(sampler,plan,rows,'fit',(step-1)*64);lr=.0003*min(step/500,1)*(1 if step<=500 else .5*(1+math.cos(math.pi*(step-500)/9500)))
  for g in opt.param_groups:g['lr']=lr
  opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);o=model(x);loss,parts=objective(o,y);assert torch.isfinite(loss);loss.backward();gn=float(torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_([p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad],1));assert np.isfinite(gn);opt.step()
  if step%25==0:row={'step':step,'loss':float(loss.detach()),'future':float(parts['future'].detach()),'tf':float(parts['tf'].detach()),'lr':lr,'gradient_norm':gn,'seconds':time.time()-start};history.append(row)
  if step%500==0:
   val,arr=evaluate(model,sampler,plan,rows,'select',objective,cfg)
   if val<best:best=val;stale=0;best_step=step;torch.save(model.state_dict(),out/'best.pt')
   else:stale+=1
   row.update(source_select_loss=val,best_step=best_step,stale=stale,patience_warning=stale>=4);(out/'curve.json').write_text(json.dumps(history,indent=2));np.savez_compressed(out/f'select_step{step}.npz',**arr)
   print(a.job,step,val,flush=True)
  assert torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated()<=20*1024**3
 torch.save(model.state_dict(),out/'step10000.pt');torch.save({'optimizer':opt.state_dict(),'step':10000},out/'optimizer_step10000.pt')
 for role in ['select','cal']:
  val,arr=evaluate(model,sampler,plan,rows,role,objective,cfg);np.savez_compressed(out/f'{role}_primary.npz',**arr)
 cal=np.load(out/'cal_primary.npz');e=np.abs(cal['prediction']-cal['target'])/cal['history_scale'];valid=cal['valid_target'];pointvalid=valid.any(-1)
 point=np.divide(np.where(valid,e,0).sum(-1),valid.sum(-1),out=np.full(pointvalid.shape,np.nan,dtype='float32'),where=pointvalid)
 scale=max(float(np.median(point[pointvalid])),1e-8);scores=point/scale;np.savez_compressed(out/'cal_scores.npz',raw_residual=point,standardized_score=scores,valid=pointvalid)
 delta={n:float((p.detach().cpu()-initial[n]).abs().max()) for n,p in model.named_parameters()};assert all(delta[n]==0 for n,p in model.named_parameters() if not p.requires_grad)
 summary={'status':'SOURCE_10K_COMPLETE','job':a.job,**j,**model.parameter_counts(),'steps':10000,'exposure_windows':640000,'seed':seed,'best_step':best_step,'primary_step':10000,
  'seconds':time.time()-start,'peak_allocated_bytes':torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),'plan_sha256':sha(pp/'plan.npz'),'trace_format':'shared uint16 record/uint32 origin/uint8 channel arrays plus entity dictionary','normal_error_scale':scale,'threshold99':float(np.quantile(scores[pointvalid],.99)),
  'parameter_changes':delta,'query_evaluated':False,'original_source_unchanged':sha(inputs['official'])==inputs['hashes'][inputs['official']]}
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2));print('COMPLETE',a.job,flush=True)
